hist-exp-01-c1.quote: it was in the third that they rounded the pillars of Heracles and came to Egypt
hist-exp-01-c1.claim: According to Herodotus, around 600 BCE the Egyptian pharaoh Necho II commissioned a Phoenician fleet to circumnavigate Africa.

hist-exp-01-c1.text: Herodotus (trans. A. D. Godley) (1920). Histories, Book 4, section 42 (Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University, via Perseids). Perseus Digital Library / Perseids, Tufts University.
hist-exp-01-c1.quote: whenever autumn came they would put in and plant the land
hist-exp-01-c1.claim: the crews planting and harvesting crops along the way
